dataset: KIC 5184732 (16 Cygni A) real global asteroseismic parameters (Kepler LEGACY sample)
source: Envelope landmark points placed at the actual measured nu_max = 2089 microHz and Delta_nu = 95.5 microHz for KIC 5184732 (16 Cygni A), a well-studied solar-type oscillator in the Kepler asteroseismic LEGACY sample, queried live from the VizieR J/ApJ/835/172 catalog (Lund et al. 2017). The relative envelope amplitude shape is illustrative; the frequency positions (nu_max and its +/-1, +/-2 large-separation neighbours) are set from the real measured parameters.
citation: Lund, M.N. et al., 2017. Standing on the shoulders of Dwarfs: the Kepler asteroseismic LEGACY sample II - Radii, masses, and ages. The Astrophysical Journal, 835(2), p.172.
requiredCitations: Aerts, C., Christensen-Dalsgaard, J. and Kurtz, D.W., 2010. Asteroseismology. Springer.
Lund, M.N. et al., 2017. Standing on the shoulders of Dwarfs: the Kepler asteroseismic LEGACY sample II - Radii, masses, and ages. The Astrophysical Journal, 835(2), p.172.
